name: Sotorasib (KRAS G12C NSCLC)
supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Monitor for hepatotoxicity (transaminase elevation), diarrhea, and nausea.

drugs.name: Sotorasib
drugs.notes: Sotorasib 960 mg PO once daily, continuous, for KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC after chemo-immunotherapy. Adagrasib 600 mg PO twice daily is an accepted alternative KRAS G12C inhibitor. Flat oral dose modeled per day of the cycle. My own wording.

provenance.locator: KRAS G12C NSCLC after prior systemic therapy (sotorasib 960 mg daily)
